Specification of Diagnostics
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
[SWS_DM_00955] Configuration of DTC "aging counter up/down" as extended
data record
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04190
⌈
If the
DiagnosticExtendedDataRecordElement
is referred by
DiagnosticE-
drDataProviderMapping.extendedDataRecordElement
and
DiagnosticE-
drDataProviderMapping.dataProvider
is set to
DEM_AGINGCTR_UPCNT
or
to
DEM_AGINGCTR_DOWNCNT
, the DM shall report the internal value of the cur-
rent aging counter of the contextual DTC in the respective
DiagnosticEx-
tendedDataRecord
’s
DiagnosticDataElement
based on [SWS_DM_00956] or
[SWS_DM_00957].
The length of this
internal data element
is one byte.
⌋
For Aging see 7.3.4.4.6.
[SWS_DM_00956] Configuration of DTC "aging counter up" as extended data
record
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04190
⌈
If the
DiagnosticExtendedDataRecordElement
is referred by
DiagnosticE-
drDataProviderMapping.extendedDataRecordElement
and
DiagnosticE-
drDataProviderMapping.dataProvider
is set to
DEM_AGINGCTR_UPCNT
, the
DM shall map the internal aging counter in such a way that a counting-up mode
from ’0’ to the
DiagnosticAging.threshold
value is created according to ISO
14229-1[1], Annex D.
The length of this
internal data element
is one byte.
⌋
[SWS_DM_00957] Configuration of DTC "aging counter down" as extended data
record
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04190
⌈
If the
DiagnosticExtendedDataRecordElement
is referred by
DiagnosticE-
drDataProviderMapping.extendedDataRecordElement
and
DiagnosticE-
drDataProviderMapping.dataProvider
is set to
DEM_AGINGCTR_DOWNCNT
,
the DM shall map the internal aging counter in such a way that a counting-down mode
from the
DiagnosticAging.threshold
value to ’0’ is created.
The length of this
internal data element
is one byte.
⌋
